meta.title: Optimize recursive dns bruteforce method
meta.body_summary: Refactor _recursive_dnsx_bruteforce method to enhance reliability, performance, and resource management by introducing thread-safe operations, proper deduplication, adaptive threading, and comprehensive resource management.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor refactored recursive DNS bruteforce; cursor[bot] identified missing -wd parameter; agent added fix commit; PR open awaiting human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 470 changed lines, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume, concentrated in main.py and a later-deleted summary doc. As an open performance refactoring PR, it has not yet been merged and awaits human maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] performed static analysis and flagged that the dnsx command in _recursive_dnsx_bruteforce was missing the `-wd {subdomain_target}` parameter, potentially causing valid subdomains to be missed; the agent responded with a targeted fix commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Enhanced reliability, performance, and resource management through thread-safe operations, deduplication, and adaptive threading.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: lock_misuse (race conditions from shared file I/O in original implementation)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent refactored complex multi-threaded I/O code but missed a critical DNS tool parameter; bot review caught the omission, and the agent quickly pushed a corrective commit. This illustrates the agent's ability to iterate on specific tool usage feedback, though performance claims remain unvalidated.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] (automated bot review, not human) detected the missing dnsx subdomain parameter.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or reproducible performance test was provided; only narrative performance claims exist.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After cursor[bot] COMMENTED, the agent added commit da0507c to fix the dnsx wordlist domain filtering, addressing the bot's concerns.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored _recursive_dnsx_bruteforce in main.py to use thread‑safe operations, deduplication, adaptive threading, and better resource management; added then removed a dnsx_optimization_summary.md document.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The summary markdown was created in the first commit and removed in the second; it does not affect runtime behavior and may have been intended as documentation.
